target.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI
target.body:
Closes #93422

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users creating or renaming Control UI chat sessions could provide a visible session name, but the gateway create/reset path did not consistently accept and persist that `displayName`. This made `/new Research Plan` and related session naming flows lose the intended name after the session was created or reset in place.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps `displayName` as session metadata owned by the gateway session APIs: `sessions.create` now accepts it, forwards it through normal dashboard session creation, and also forwards it when `session.dmScope='main'` resets the parent session in place. The Control UI slash-command flow passes typed `/new <name>` values through the real page adapter into session creation, `/label <name>` patches the active session name, and new-chat parent selection avoids unknown, synthetic, and fallback main rows so session lineage stays tied to persisted sessions only.

The generated Swift protocol model is updated from the gateway schema. The change intentionally stays within session naming and parent-selection behavior; it does not change model routing, auth, archive/pin semantics, or transcript storage format.

## User Impact

Users can create a named chat from the Control UI with `/new Research Plan` and see that name persist through the gateway session store and session list. Users can also rename the current chat with `/label <name>` without waiting for an active run to finish.

## Evidence

- Local gateway RPC proof captured after the patch: `sessions.create` accepted `displayName: "Research Plan"`, `sessions.list` returned the created session with that display name, `sessions.patch` changed it to `"Work Plan"`, and the session store persisted the patched display name.
- Focused gateway validation passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.create.test.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.reset-hooks.test.ts src/gateway/sessions-patch.test.ts` — 5 files passed, 211 tests passed.
- Focused Control UI validation passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-commands.test.ts` — 4 files passed, 115 tests passed, including a real `ChatPage` adapter regression for typed `/new <name>` and typed `/label <name>` local patch coverage.
- Swift protocol generation was rerun and verified idempotent after the schema update.
